opportunities_custom_stage_check.name: opportunities_custom_stage_check
opportunities_custom_stage_check.value: ("opportunities"."stage" = 'custom' and "opportunities"."pipeline_stage_key" is not null) or ("opportunities"."stage" <> 'custom' and "opportunities"."pipeline_stage_key" is null)

opportunity_stage_history_from_custom_st.name: opportunity_stage_history_from_custom_stage_check
opportunity_stage_history_from_custom_st.value: ("opportunity_stage_history"."from_stage" is null and "opportunity_stage_history"."from_pipeline_stage_key" is null) or ("opportunity_stage_history"."from_stage" = 'custom' and "opportunity_stage_history"."from_pipeline_stage_key" is not null) or ("opportunity_stage_history"."from_stage" is not null and "opportunity_stage_history"."from_stage" <> 'custom' and "opportunity_stage_history"."from_pipeline_stage_key" is null)

opportunity_stage_history_to_custom_stag.name: opportunity_stage_history_to_custom_stage_check
opportunity_stage_history_to_custom_stag.value: ("opportunity_stage_history"."to_stage" = 'custom' and "opportunity_stage_history"."to_pipeline_stage_key" is not null) or ("opportunity_stage_history"."to_stage" <> 'custom' and "opportunity_stage_history"."to_pipeline_stage_key" is null)

pipeline_stages_name_check.name: pipeline_stages_name_check
pipeline_stages_name_check.value: "pipeline_stages"."is_system" or ("pipeline_stages"."name" is not null and length(trim("pipeline_stages"."name")) between 2 and 64)
